d: The artificial intelligence revolution is transforming businesses, promising greater efficiency, faster decisions and reduced costs. But behind the promise of productivity lies a growing workforce crisis. German software giant SAP is reportedly planning to eliminate around 10,000 jobs as it accelerates its AI strategy. Meanwhile, Swiggy Instamart is cutting approximately 340 roles amid mounting pressure to improve profitability. HSBC is consolidating finance operations in India, while reportedly considering much larger workforce reductions globally. Across the technology sector, automation…
